text.tspan: May solder PicoW directly to board using pins at shown vias
7 pc single pins for Pi Pico W, or femail headers as shown
1 pc 8 pin femail short header for BMP280 as barometer
2 pc JST-XH 4 pin shrouded mail socket for I2C bus
1 pc JST-XH 3 pin shrouded mail socket for one-wire bus
1 pc double mail header for jumper
